translations.literal: Shi Yu was a man of Ningling.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yu was a native of Ningling.

translations.literal: On An Dun's recommendation he was made Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On An Dun's recommendation he was appointed investigating censor.

translations.zh: 與左膚鞠鄒浩獄，文致重比，又使廣東鍾正甫逮治浩，欲致之死。
translations.literal: Together with Zuo Fu he tried Zou Hao's case, twisting charges into grave statutes; he also had Guangdong envoy Zhong Zhengfu seize and prosecute Hao, intending to bring about his death.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Zuo Fu he tried Zou Hao's case, fabricating grave charges; he also had Guangdong envoy Zhong Zhengfu seize and prosecute Hao, intending to bring about his death.

translations.zh: 豫論邊事，謂中國與四夷，相交為君臣，相與為賓客。
translations.literal: Yu discussed frontier affairs, saying that China and the four barbarians alternately served as lord and subject and treated one another as host and guest.
translations.idiomatic: Yu discussed frontier affairs, arguing that China and the four barbarians alternately served as lord and subject and treated one another as host and guest.

translations.zh: 徽宗以其言無倫理，且辱國，出為淮南轉運判官。
translations.literal: Huizong, because his words were irrational and moreover insulted the state, sent him out as transport intendant of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong, finding his words irrational and insulting to the state, sent him out as transport intendant of Huainan.

translations.zh: 陳瓘又追論羅織鄒浩事，降通判亳州。
translations.literal: Chen Guan again pursued the matter of fabricated charges against Zou Hao, and he was demoted to vice prefect of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guan again pursued the matter of fabricated charges against Zou Hao, and Shi Yu was demoted to vice prefect of Bozhou.

translations.zh: 崇寧元年，召拜殿中侍御史。
translations.literal: In the first year of Chongning he was summoned and appointed Attending Censor within the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Chongning era he was summoned and appointed Attending Censor within the Palace.

translations.zh: 遂同錢遹造廢元祐皇后議，亟遷待御史，至中丞。
translations.literal: Thereupon, together with Qian Yu, he framed the proposal to depose the Yuanyou Empress; he was swiftly transferred to Remonstrating Secretary and reached Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon, together with Qian Yu, he framed the proposal to depose the Yuanyou Empress; he was swiftly promoted to Remonstrating Secretary and rose to Censor-in-Chief.

translations.zh: 請削去景靈宮繪像臣僚，自文彥博、司馬光、呂公著、呂大防、范純仁、劉摯、范百祿、梁燾、王岩叟以下。
translations.literal: He requested removal of the painted likenesses of officials at Jingling Palace, from Wen Yanbo, Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, Lü Dafang, Fan Chunren, Liu Zhi, Fan Bailu, Liang Tao, and Wang Yansou downward.
translations.idiomatic: He requested removal of the painted likenesses of officials at Jingling Palace, from Wen Yanbo, Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, Lü Dafang, Fan Chunren, Liu Zhi, Fan Bailu, Liang Tao, and Wang Yansou downward.

translations.zh: 既，以論罷軍器監蔡碩，碩訟豫平生交通狀，黜知陳州，徙鄧州。
translations.literal: Shortly afterward, because of a memorial he had the Director of the Armaments Directorate Cai Shuo dismissed; Shuo sued over Yu's lifelong record of illicit dealings; Yu was demoted to prefect of Chenzhou and transferred to Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, because of a memorial he had Director of the Armaments Directorate Cai Shuo dismissed; Shuo sued over Yu's lifelong record of illicit dealings, and Yu was demoted to prefect of Chenzhou and transferred to Dengzhou.

translations.zh: 過闕，留為工部侍郎，進戶部，兼侍讀。
translations.literal: Passing the capital, he was retained as Vice Minister of Works, advanced to the Ministry of Revenue, and concurrently made Lecturer-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Passing the capital, he was retained as vice minister of works, promoted to the Ministry of Revenue, and concurrently made Lecturer-in-Attendance.

translations.zh: 以調度不繼，降秩一等，徙刑部。
translations.literal: Because fiscal allocations were not sustained, his rank was lowered one grade and he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Because fiscal allocations fell short, his rank was lowered one grade and he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.

translations.zh: 祖母死，用嫡孫承重去官，服未闋而卒。
translations.literal: When his grandmother died, as principal grandson bearing the ancestral weight he left office; before mourning was completed he died.
translations.idiomatic: When his grandmother died, as principal grandson bearing the ancestral mourning obligation he left office; before the mourning period was complete he died.
